name: project-workflow
description: Close the spec gaps before any code is written: a project-manager orchestrator runs three interview layers in sequence — project-spec (Goal, Scope, Non-goals, Constraints), project-verify (measurable evaluation criteria and external success signals), and project-environment (AGENTS.md, knowledge-base, skill, and guardrail gaps, with drafted hook configs) — each writing to specs/<slug>/ behind an explicit human sign-off at every checkpoint.
